name: Thunderbolt Pose
intro:
Thunderbolt Pose (Vajrasana) is a simple yet powerful seated yoga posture known for its strong grounding and digestive benefits. In this pose, the practitioner sits on the heels with the spine upright, creating a stable and steady position for both physical and mental balance. Unlike most yoga poses, Vajrasana can be safely practiced after meals, making it highly effective for improving digestion and metabolism.

This posture helps channel energy through the body while promoting calmness and focus. It encourages proper posture by aligning the spine and strengthening the lower back. Vajrasana is also widely used as a base pose for meditation and breathing exercises (pranayama) because it allows for comfortable, steady sitting over longer durations.

Regular practice of Thunderbolt Pose helps reduce stress, enhances concentration, and supports overall well-being. It is especially beneficial for people suffering from digestive issues, acidity, or bloating. By simply sitting in this posture and focusing on breathing, the body experiences improved circulation and a sense of inner stability and relaxation.

steps.text: Kneel on the mat with your knees together or slightly apart.
Bring your big toes together and sit back on your heels.
Place your hands on your thighs with palms facing down.
Keep your spine straight and look forward.
Breathe slowly and hold the position comfortably.

benefits: Strengthens the lower back and improves posture
Calms the mind and reduces stress
Promotes overall mental and physical stability
avoid: You have severe knee pain or knee injury
You are suffering from ankle injuries
You have ligament issues in the legs
You feel numbness or sharp pain while sitting
You have recent surgery in legs or knees
You have severe arthritis (consult a doctor before practice)
You experience discomfort while sitting on heels
